summary: settle the strategy component boundary and the two sample-size and bar-definition gaps in docs/spec
owner_direction:
Owner direction 2026-09-19 (SPEC layer). Settle in docs/spec what the next Developer would otherwise have to invent. Every change must tighten or clarify, never relax: do not remove a Must not clause, an acceptance criterion, or a safety, risk, promotion or precision rule; do not change task status, attempt, commits, evidence pointers or approval fields; do not activate a task. A named contract may be adjusted only where the specification correction makes its current text wrong; state that basis for each. All four targets are PLANNED.

(1) STRATEGY_ECONOMICS.md section 7 lists seven substitutable components, and three problems follow from that list. It names StrategyDecision as a component, but StrategyDecision is the backtest engine's callback return type, and T060 forbids a component name denoting an output. It names AdmissionEligibilitySnapshot and MarketFeatureSnapshot, while the implemented and contract-specified snapshots are AdmissionSnapshot, MarketSnapshot and PortfolioSnapshot, so the specification omits PortfolioSnapshot and uses two names nothing else uses. It names CandidatePolicy and EconomicEvaluator, which appear nowhere else: no task contract, no acceptance, no code, no reference. Make section 7 name only components and outputs that either exist or are assigned to a task, keep the rule that a component name never denotes an output and vice versa, and state explicitly how the engine's strategy callback relates to these components: which of the two is the boundary a backtest actually crosses today and which task owns the adapter between them. T060, T061 and T062 are APPROVED, so do not edit them; if the correction makes T065's or T102's text wrong, adjust that text and say why.

(2) DATASET_AND_EVALUATION.md DS-030 justifies the deliberately small model families with the retired ten-million-block window, which ADR-015 forbids any later clause from citing as the research range. Restate the sample-size basis on the per-pool extended-history window ADR-015 establishes, keeping the substance (the measured sample size is the binding constraint) and the concrete numbers only where they follow from that window.

(3) The confirmed rule that a complete five-minute target-token USDG return above 100 percent suppresses risk-increasing candidates has no definition of the bar it measures. OPERATOR_CONTROL.md defines the minus 80 percent condition as a complete bar's close over open minus one and states that an incomplete period must not trigger; give the plus 100 percent rule the same treatment in the strategy specification, so both confirmed five-minute rules have one stated formula and one stated bar convention, and say whether they share the alignment and clock convention already required for five-minute bars.

(4) T064 now carries a scenario catalogue in the contract itself, where each entry declares halt with a named reason code or degrade to a named deterministic fallback. Decide and state whether that halt-or-degrade obligation belongs in DATASET_AND_EVALUATION.md, and if it does, define it there and reduce T064's text to a reference; if it does not, record in the specification why the contract is the right home. Either way the two documents must not both define it.

Nothing outside docs/spec/ and the four named contracts may change.
